title: Pages
empty: No pages yet. Pick a template, or ask the assistant e.g. “make me a presentation of the results for management” — it writes the page, you see it here and share it by link or with people from your team.
emptyTeam: Nobody from the team has shared a page with you yet.
writing: The assistant is writing the page… it usually takes a minute or more. You can keep chatting; the finished page shows up here by itself.
writingSteps: The assistant writes the page section by section — the preview grows with every step.

krok.kostra: Look and skeleton of the page

codeHint: Show the HTML as it is written instead of the preview
queued: The page is waiting to be written.
failed: The page could not be written.
openHint: Open the page in a new tab
shareOn: The link is on — anyone with the link can open the page, no account needed.
shareNewHint: Replaces the link with a new one; the old one stops working.
copyFailed: Copying failed — copy the link by hand.
team: Whole team (every member of the organization)
teamHint: On: every member of the organization finds the page in the Shared with me tab.

lide.hint: Who can open the page — like sharing a project: pick members of the organization, or the whole team at once.

restored: Previous version restored (click again to redo).
notFound: Page not found (maybe it was deleted).
errorLoad: The page could not be loaded.
sandboxNote: The page runs in an isolated sandbox — it has no access to your app or your sign-in.

nova.intro: Choose what the page should be. The app turns it into a brief for the assistant — it loads the project, writes the page and you share it.
nova.projektVeta: Base it on the project “{{projekt}}” — load it and use only facts from it.
nova.bezProjektu: No project — use only what I write here and ask about anything missing.

stylVeta.svetly: Look: light, modern, readable on a phone.
stylVeta.firemni: Look: plain corporate, white background, tables and a clear structure.

nova.doplneniPlaceholder: E.g. stress the delivery delay, add the manager's contact…
nova.zadaniPlaceholder: E.g. an interactive price calculator by hours and rate…

vedeni.popis: Project status, deadlines, who owns what, risks and next steps
vedeni.zprava: Make me a page: a presentation of the project for management — status, key deadlines, who owns what, risks and next steps. Stat cards with the key numbers at the top, a chart of step statuses and a timeline of deadlines; an icon for every part.

tym.popis: Who does what, what is on fire, this week's deadlines
tym.zprava: Make me a page: a project overview for the team — who owns what, what is on fire right now, this week's deadlines and what is done. A traffic light for each part, progress bars and icons; highlight what is on fire.

zakaznik.popis: Milestones, what is done, what we need from them — no internal details
zakaznik.zprava: Make me a page: a project summary for the customer — milestones, what is done, what comes next and what we need from the customer; no internal notes, budgets or assignee names. A milestone timeline and an overall progress bar; clear, with icons.

osa.popis: Milestones and steps on a timeline with dates
osa.zprava: Make me a page: a project timeline — milestones and steps ordered by deadline, what is done, what is in progress and what is still ahead. As a Gantt chart by deadlines with a today marker, a status overview below it; icons for the parts.

report.popis: One page with a traffic light: green / amber / red
report.zprava: Make me a page: a one-page project status report with a traffic light (green / amber / red) for each part, the key numbers, what went well and what is stuck. The traffic light as coloured dots, stat cards and a chart of done / running / waiting shares.

checklist.popis: Interactive tick-off list built from the project steps
checklist.zprava: Make me a page: an interactive checklist built from the project steps — each step as an item with a checkbox, its deadline and owner, and a counter of done items at the top. A progress bar at the top and status icons on the items.
